title: Notebook quantity picker
goal: Choose 1–5 notebooks, show the total, and reset the quantity. Explain your state choices instead of copying the tutorial code.

steps.title: Plan the UI and rules
steps.task: Sketch the quantity, total, plus, minus, and reset controls. Write the allowed range.
steps.check: Quantities 0 and 6 are not allowed. The price is fixed.
steps.reason: Clear acceptance criteria help you decide what to build.

steps.title: Choose the minimum state
steps.task: Add one quantity state variable at the top level of App.
steps.code:
const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
const total = quantity * UNIT_PRICE;
steps.check: The total does not need a setter.
steps.reason: Calculating the total avoids keeping duplicate values in sync.

steps.title: Add increase and decrease actions
steps.task: Use functional updaters to enforce the limits.
steps.code:
const increase = () => setQuantity(q => Math.min(MAX, q + 1));
const decrease = () => setQuantity(q => Math.max(MIN, q - 1));
steps.check: Repeated increases stop at 5. Repeated decreases stop at 1.
steps.reason: The update logic must enforce the rules too.

steps.title: Connect the controls
steps.task: Add named buttons, disable them at the limits, and show the total.
steps.check: The buttons work with a keyboard. The plus button is disabled at the maximum.
steps.reason: A visual symbol also needs a clear accessible name.

steps.title: Add reset
steps.task: Set quantity back to its initial value when Reset is clicked.
steps.check: Resetting from 5 gives quantity 1 and total 120.
steps.reason: The total updates from quantity, so it needs no extra setter.

steps.title: Build it again without the example
steps.task: Close the final code and rebuild the feature in a blank App.jsx file.
steps.check: Pass every acceptance scenario below and explain each state choice.
steps.reason: Move from following instructions to building independently.

extensions: Make price a prop and explain why total still is derived.
Support changing stock: define what happens when stock becomes zero before changing code.
Share quantity with a sibling order summary by lifting state.
